rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
artistic_choices: Declined under GAMBAR6.5 rather than invent a body or depict clothing as a deity.
reason: Accepted claims document birth from discarded trousers and road-junction meaning, but no bodily form, iconography, or visually active manifestation. A humanoid emerging from trousers would invent anatomy; trousers alone or road landscape would fail subject/Sangar requirements.
